> Team — forwarding a reference request from FinTech Co. (deal FIN-2026-1123).

Quick thoughts: we should protect the same customers from back-to-back asks — reference fatigue is already causing multiple declines this quarter. Recommend we present three structured options to Caroline (ranked):
1) 30-min live call with a payments-adjacent customer (limited to 1 live call per customer per 30 days)
2) 15-min recorded testimonial (we provide questions; customer records at their convenience)
3) An anonymized one-page case study with metrics redacted as needed + 10% usage credit applied at contract signature

I'll check with CS for customers who fit the bill and are under the 30-day window. If none are available, we push option 2 or 3. Also suggest offering a small account credit as a thank-you for live calls — standard practice and easy to approve.

Marcus

That said, we've built a process for this exact situation — attaching the team reference rotation policy and a shortlist of alternative assets we can use (anonymized case study template, short recorded Q&A flow, and an intake form for customers to opt into future calls).

Hi Caroline — thanks for the details and the timeline. Quick update on options so you can choose what works best for your committee: 

Option A — Live 30-min call (preferred by buyers): we can offer a live call with a payments-adjacent customer, EdgePayments (Linda Cho). Linda has availability on June 18 or June 21, both 30-min windows. Note: we limit customers to one live call per 30-day period to avoid reference fatigue.

Option B — 15-min recorded testimonial: we send a short question set and the customer records at their convenience. Turnaround target: 5–7 business days.

Option C — An anonymized one-pager case study (fastest): we redact identifying details and provide key outcomes + a 10% usage credit applied at signature.

If you prefer Option A, pick a slot and we'll connect you directly to Linda (contact: Linda Cho <linda@edgepayments.com>). If Option B or C works better, we'll get started immediately.

Links:
- Schedule (if you want to pick a slot): https://cal.com/fintech-demo/30
- Case study template / guidelines: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/ref-rotation-guidelines

Best,
Neha Kapoor
